### EQ-PRECISION-FUNCTIONS — Four Trotter-Suzuki precision functions

*Defines the error observable searched by every frozen target.*

$$
\begin{aligned}\hat\epsilon_{1,\mathrm{det}}&=\frac{x^2}{N}e^{x/N},\\ \hat\epsilon_{1,\mathrm{ran}}=\hat\epsilon_{2,\mathrm{det}}&=\frac{x^3}{3N^2}e^{x/N},\\ \hat\epsilon_{2,\mathrm{ran}}&=\frac{(t\lambda)^3M^2}{N^2}e^{x/N},\qquad x=t\lambda M.\end{aligned}
$$

status: `verified` · derived from: `paper Table 1 with x=t lambda M` · source: paper_table: Table 1, precision-function column; paper_equation: Eqs. (11)-(12)

Numerical form:

```
log_precision_error(method,t,lambda,M,N); exponentiate only after the logarithmic comparison is safe.
```

Code: `code/src/trotter_bounds.py::log_precision_error`, `code/src/trotter_bounds.py::precision_error`


### EQ-ANALYTIC-BOUNDS — Sufficient analytic step-count bounds

*Generates the N_analytic series in all eight panels.*

$$
\begin{aligned}N^{a}_{1,\mathrm{det}}&=\left\lceil\max\{x,e x^2/\epsilon\}\right\rceil,\\N^{a}_{1,\mathrm{ran}}=N^{a}_{2,\mathrm{det}}&=\left\lceil\max\{x,\sqrt{e x^3/(3\epsilon)}\}\right\rceil,\\N^{a}_{2,\mathrm{ran}}&=\left\lceil\max\{x,\sqrt{e(t\lambda)^3M^2/\epsilon}\}\right\rceil.\end{aligned}
$$

status: `verified` · derived from: `EQ-PRECISION-FUNCTIONS` · source: paper_equation: Eqs. (14), (20), (22), and (24); paper_proof: Proposition 1 proof, Eqs. (15)-(18)

Numerical form:

### EQ-LAMBERT-W-CROSSCHECK — Continuous threshold solved with Lambert W

*Provides an independent analytic check of the integer binary search.*

$$
\begin{aligned}N_*^{(p=1)}&=\frac{x}{W(\epsilon/x)},\\N_*^{(p=2)}&=\frac{x}{2W\!\left(\frac{x}{2}\sqrt{\epsilon/A}\right)},\quad \hat\epsilon=A N^{-2}e^{x/N}.\end{aligned}
$$

status: `verified` · derived from: `EQ-PRECISION-FUNCTIONS` · source: derived_from_paper: Table 1 precision functions; this closed-form cross-check is not stated in the paper

Numerical form:

```
continuous_threshold(method,t,lambda,M,epsilon), checked only against the independently searched integer N.
```
